name: GAO-25-107546 Other Transaction Agreement Effectiveness Review
update_frequency: One-time oversight report with recommendation follow-up
known_limitations: GAO reviewed department-wide data and a nongeneralizable sample of 18 weapon-system efforts. The report establishes a systemic tracking limitation; it does not evaluate the OpenAI agreement or determine the outcome of any specific prototype OTA outside the selected sample.
automation_notes: Track implementation of GAO's two recommendations and pair individual prototype agreements with later obligations, delivery, acceptance, fielding, and production records.
notes: GAO reported that DOD systematically tracks production OTAs but lacks a reliable method to identify FAR production contracts that resulted from prototype OTAs.
